Regarding the symptoms described for Derek, a persistent dry cough lasting more than three weeks combined with new-onset shortness of breath during physical activity could indicate several potential medical conditions. These may include respiratory infections such as bronchitis or pneumonia, asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), or potentially more serious conditions like heart failure or pulmonary embolism. It is important for Derek to consult a healthcare professional for a proper diagnosis and treatment plan.
